ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (light grey/white) to 30% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigmentation cluster at the fluke base radiating outward. Continuous dark mottling and irregular banding along the trailing edges of both lobes. Distinct, spatially separated dark spots visible on the medial-to-lateral region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 55 degrees; depth is approximately 1/8th of the vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by multiple peaks and U-shaped indentations with pixel-amplitudes varying between 5 and 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edges follow a prominent concave curve from the median notch toward the distal tips; the leading edges exhibit a slight convex sweep visible at the lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially concentrated cluster of dark circular spots on the mid-right lobe; a singular high-contrast circular ring mark on the upper-left lobe near the leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented diagonally on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel rake marks on the left lobe; a significant jagged notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the terminal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A radiating, sunburst-like pigmentation pattern at the point of peduncle insertion.
